data.title: Tiler
data.summary: The role covers full wet-room renovations, from protection, demolition and substrate work to waterproofing, tiling and fixture installation. It may also include suspended ceilings and finishing work at changing sites.

requirements.text: Experience in tiling and waterproofing work
Ability to work independently and systematically
requirements.question: What does 'independent and systematic work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for independent and systematic work without describing what it involves day to day.

requirements.question: What does 'careful workmanship' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for careful workmanship without giving a concrete quality standard or example.

requirements.text: Access to a car for travel between changing work sites
Prior work experience and professional tiling skill
requirements.question: What does 'professional tiling skill' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requires work experience and professional skill without specifying the expected tasks or proficiency.

requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires strong Finnish but does not say whether it is needed immediately for every task.
